tasks.title: Scaffold clean Flutter app structure
tasks.description: Scaffolded clean Flutter app with core/theme, core/router, features/generate, features/tickets.

tasks.title: Port Generate ticket screen with BLoC
tasks.description: GeneratePage + GenerateCubit with working color/shape/bg/image/code actions.

tasks.title: Add GenerateQRCode widget and deps
tasks.description: GenerateQrCode via qr_flutter; deps: flutter_bloc, go_router, google_fonts, equatable.

tasks.title: Add Tickets list screen + navigation
tasks.description: TicketsPage + HomeShell bottom nav via go_router StatefulShellRoute.

tasks.title: Write full GitHub documentation (ISO + security)
tasks.description: Added GitHub community health files, docs architecture/features/security/privacy, ISO alignment mapping, issue/PR templates, Dependabot, and secret-hardened gitignore.
tasks.details: Aligned with GitHub docs community health guidance; ISO/IEC 27001/27701/29147/30111/12207/25010 mapping. No formal certification claim.

tasks.title: Remove legacy tooling mentions from code and docs
tasks.description: Scrubbed remaining legacy low-code tooling references from theme comments, CONTRIBUTING, architecture/development docs, and TaskManager backup text.

tasks.title: Create feature/top-bg-gradient branch
tasks.description: Saved outstanding TaskManager tracking, updated main from origin, and created local branch feature/top-bg-gradient for top ticket background gradient work.

tasks.title: Top background solid/gradient customizer sheet
tasks.description: Replaced top Bg color cycle with a modal bottom sheet: Solid Color (presets + hex) and Gradient Color (Color A/B hex). Cubit updates topGradientStart/End; sheet dismisses after valid apply.
tasks.details: Files: top_bg_color_customizer_sheet.dart, ticket_header_section.dart, generate_cubit.dart (applyTopBackgroundSolid/Hex, setTopBackgroundGradient, tryParseHexColor).

tasks.title: Make My Ticket, title, and subtitle editable
tasks.description: Added Ticket.headerLabel and borderless TextFields for My Ticket, Circu Du Freak, and Vision & Sound Experience; wired to GenerateCubit with transparent decorations and keyboard inset padding.
tasks.details: Files: ticket.dart (headerLabel), generate_cubit.dart (updateHeaderLabel/updateTitle/updateSubtitle), generate_page.dart (controllers), ticket_header_section.dart, ticket_details_section.dart.

tasks.title: Build and run Flutter app on macOS
tasks.description: Ran flutter pub get and flutter run -d macos. Enabled com.apple.security.network.client so google_fonts can load over the network.

tasks.title: Adaptive ticket text color from background luminance
tasks.description: Added ColorContrast utility and wired top/bottom ticket sections so text, cursors, and icons switch between dark and light for readable contrast on custom gradients.

tasks.title: Task 2.4 Bottom-Half Enhancements
tasks.description: Branch feature/bottom-half-upgrades from main (FF Task 2.3). image_picker gallery → Ticket.imagePath + Image.file with asset fallback; date then time pickers; bottom BoxDecoration uses shared topGradient colors; cubit syncs both halves.
tasks.details: Also added placeholder asset, iOS/macOS photo usage strings and macOS photo entitlements.

tasks.title: Task 2.5 Tickets Database, Local State, & Sharing
tasks.description: Branch feature/ticket-persistence-sharing from main (FF Task 2.4). shared_preferences JSON persistence, empty Tickets list, Save Ticket on Generate, share_plus Share sheet on each card.

tasks.title: Fix ticket Share sheet with Share.share + origin
tasks.description: Extracted SavedTicketCard; share icon now calls Share.share() with sharePositionOrigin from the button RenderBox so the iOS native sheet presents.

tasks.title: Bulletproof iOS Share.share with sharePositionOrigin
tasks.description: SavedTicketCard now builds an explicit share string (title/venue/date) and calls Share.share with subject My Custom Ticket Design plus a non-zero sharePositionOrigin for iOS/iPadOS anchoring.
tasks.details: Venue falls back from subtitle; date uses dateLabel (Ticket has no location/date fields).

tasks.title: Reset Generate form to defaults after Save Ticket
tasks.description: Added GenerateCubit.resetToDefault(); after successful save, emit default ticket and sync header/title/subtitle controllers.

tasks.title: Add STAR-method PORTFOLIO.md write-up
tasks.description: Created root PORTFOLIO.md documenting Quick Ticket Maker enhancements (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
tasks.details: Covers editable text, contrast, gradients, image_picker, date/time, shared_preferences, share_plus.

tasks.title: Hide ticket field brackets while editing
tasks.description: Added BracketedTicketField; header/title/subtitle show [ ] when idle and hide them on focus.
tasks.details: bracketed_ticket_field.dart; wired in ticket_header_section.dart and ticket_details_section.dart. Date/time and ticket code keep display brackets.

tasks.title: Keep brackets hidden until new ticket session
tasks.description: Brackets dismiss on first focus and stay hidden until Save Ticket resets the form (_ticketSession / resetToken).
tasks.details: BracketedTicketField sticky _showBrackets; generate_page bumps session after resetToDefault.

tasks.title: Live-update bg color preview from hex input
tasks.description: Hex typing updates the solid/gradient display bar and ticket background as soon as #RRGGBB is valid; Apply still dismisses the sheet.
tasks.details: top_bg_color_customizer_sheet.dart — local preview + live cubit apply on valid parse.

tasks.title: Add Discover and Account bottom tabs
tasks.description: Extended HomeShell NavigationBar with Discover and Account branches; placeholder pages under features/discover and features/account.
tasks.details: Tab order: Generate, Discover, Tickets, Account. Widget test covers tab navigation.
